detailed_description: The PDF Merger combines two or more PDF files into one document in your browser. It uses pdf-lib to read each uploaded PDF, count pages, copy all pages in the order shown, and save a new merged PDF. After selecting files, you can review file names and page counts, move files up or down to set the merge order, remove files you do not want, and choose the output file name before downloading. This is useful for joining reports, invoices, scanned packets, or related documents without installing desktop software.
usage_steps: Click the upload area and select two or more PDF files
Review each file name and page count in the file list
Use the up and down buttons to arrange the merge order
Remove any PDF you do not want to include
Enter the output file name if you want to change the default
Click Merge PDFs to download the combined PDF
usage_examples: Combine monthly invoice PDFs into one file before sending them to accounting
Merge several scanned forms into a single packet for archiving
Join report sections exported as separate PDFs into one document
Reorder uploaded PDFs before creating a combined handout
